onboarding_support.role: Diagnostic and remedial on-ramp for isolated words, formulaic expressions, and foundational recognition.

internal_milestones.role: Internal progress milestone within the A2-to-B1 journey.
Internal progress milestone within the B1-to-B2 journey.
Internal progress milestone within the B2-to-C1 journey.

exit_promise.text: Handle concrete personal details and immediate needs with learnt language and a collaborative partner.

listening.text: Recognise familiar words and very basic phrases when delivery is slow, clear, and context-supported.

reading.text: Understand familiar names, words, signs, and very simple sentences in predictable material.

speaking.text: Use isolated simple phrases and sentences for personal details, familiar people, places, possessions, and needs.

writing.text: Produce isolated phrases and sentences and complete very simple personal-detail forms or messages.

oral.text: Ask and answer simple questions with repetition, rephrasing, slower speech, and formulation help.

written_online.text: Post simple greetings or reactions and complete a very simple purchase or personal-details form.

mediation.text: Relay simple predictable information from short signs or notices and show welcome, interest, or understanding.

range.text: Very basic expressions and some one-clause structures for concrete personal information and needs.

grammar.text: Limited control of a few learnt simple structures and sentence patterns.

vocabulary.text: Basic words and phrases tied to particular concrete situations.

pronunciation.text: A limited learnt repertoire is intelligible with effort and collaborative support.

discourse.text: Link words or groups mainly with very basic linear connectors such as and or then.

fluency.text: Manage very short pre-packaged utterances with substantial pausing and repair.

assessment_evidence.text: A new concrete personal or immediate-need task
No copying of a complete model
Support may clarify but not supply the response

exit_promise.text: Complete simple routine exchanges and describe the immediate world through linked simple language.

listening.text: Understand high-frequency language of immediate relevance and the main point of short clear messages.

reading.text: Read short simple texts and locate predictable information in everyday materials and personal correspondence.

speaking.text: Use a series of simple phrases and sentences to describe family, background, routines, and immediate surroundings.

writing.text: Produce a series of simple phrases and sentences linked by frequent connectors.

oral.text: Complete routine tasks and short social exchanges through direct familiar information exchange.

written_online.text: Handle basic social interaction, routine transactions, simple instructions, and supported collaboration.

mediation.text: Convey main points of short simple everyday texts and collaborate on practical tasks with occasional repetition.

range.text: Basic patterns and memorised phrases for predictable everyday content, with message compromise outside routine situations.

grammar.text: Some simple structures are correct, though systematic basic mistakes remain and meaning is usually clear.

vocabulary.text: Sufficient for routine transactions, basic communicative needs, and simple survival situations.

pronunciation.text: Generally understandable in familiar situations, though repetition and listener effort may be needed.

discourse.text: Link simple sentences with frequent connectors such as and, but, and because.

fluency.text: Make short understandable contributions with visible hesitation, false starts, and reformulation.

assessment_evidence.text: Successful repair after a bounded misunderstanding

exit_promise.text: Operate independently in familiar life, travel, work, and personal-interest situations using connected language.

listening.text: Understand main points of clear standard input and relatively clear media on familiar or personally relevant topics.

reading.text: Understand high-frequency everyday or job-related texts and descriptions of events, feelings, and wishes.

speaking.text: Connect phrases to narrate experiences and events and give brief reasons for opinions, hopes, and plans.

writing.text: Produce straightforward connected text on familiar or personally interesting topics.

oral.text: Enter unprepared conversation on familiar topics and handle most common situations while travelling.

written_online.text: Interact about experiences and feelings, ask for clarification, and answer comments in some detail.

mediation.text: Convey familiar information from clear texts, seek simple compromise, and support shared communication.

range.text: Sufficient familiar-topic language for some unpredictable situations, with hesitation and circumlocution when limits appear.

grammar.text: Reasonable accuracy in familiar contexts; errors and first-language influence remain but intended meaning is clear.

vocabulary.text: Good range for familiar topics and everyday life, with limitations on unfamiliar or complex ideas.

pronunciation.text: Generally intelligible despite regular mispronunciation and noticeable first-language influence.

discourse.text: Link shorter elements into a connected linear sequence with simple paragraphing and chronological control.

fluency.text: Keep going comprehensibly despite evident pauses for planning and repair.

assessment_evidence.text: A reasoned response in more than one context

exit_promise.text: Understand and produce clear detailed language, sustain viewpoints, and interact with useful spontaneity.

listening.text: Follow extended talk and complex argument on reasonably familiar topics and understand most standard-language news and film.

reading.text: Understand articles and reports with viewpoints, contemporary prose, and relevant technical discussion.

speaking.text: Give clear detailed descriptions and explain a viewpoint with advantages, disadvantages, and supporting detail.

writing.text: Produce clear detailed texts, essays, and reports that present information or support a position.

oral.text: Participate actively with useful fluency and spontaneity, sustain views, and manage routine disagreement.

written_online.text: Collaborate in multi-person tasks and handle misunderstanding when others remain reasonably cooperative.

mediation.text: Relay detailed information and arguments reliably, clarify complex points, and develop or connect others' ideas.

range.text: Broad general and field-related language, viewpoints, argument, and some complex sentence forms without much restriction.

grammar.text: Relatively high control with occasional slips and some rigid or inaccurate use of complex forms.

vocabulary.text: Good general and field-related range with systematic use of many appropriate collocations.

pronunciation.text: Intelligible throughout; accent has little effect and prosody generally supports the intended message.

discourse.text: Use varied linking expressions, cohesive devices, supporting detail, and clear logical paragraphs.

fluency.text: Sustain longer stretches at a fairly even tempo with few conspicuously long pauses.

assessment_evidence.text: A supported viewpoint for a new audience and topic

exit_promise.text: Use English flexibly for complex social, academic, and professional purposes, including implicit meaning.

listening.text: Understand extended discourse with implicit relationships and demanding media without excessive effort.

reading.text: Understand long complex factual, literary, specialised, and technical texts while appreciating style distinctions.

speaking.text: Present complex subjects with integrated sub-themes, developed points, and an appropriate conclusion.

writing.text: Produce clear well-structured detailed texts on complex subjects in a style appropriate to the reader.

oral.text: Express ideas fluently and precisely, adapt register, and relate contributions skilfully to others.

written_online.text: Handle complex abstract interaction and communication problems through flexible register, clarification, and exemplification.

mediation.text: Convey significant ideas from long complex texts and evaluate and connect multiple perspectives.

range.text: Broad complex language selected flexibly for clear social, academic, and professional communication.

grammar.text: Consistently high accuracy; errors are rare and difficult to notice.

vocabulary.text: Broad lexical and idiomatic command with effective circumlocution and little obvious searching.

pronunciation.text: Full phonological range with intelligibility throughout; retained accent does not affect effectiveness.

discourse.text: Produce smooth, well-structured language with controlled organisational patterns and cohesive devices.

fluency.text: Express complex thought almost effortlessly, with only conceptually difficult material affecting flow.

assessment_evidence.text: A complex position in multiple domains
Audience and register adaptation without rehearsed wording

exit_promise.text: Synthesize complex sources and communicate precise nuances with consistently appropriate language.

listening.text: Understand with ease virtually any kind of live or recorded language, including delivery at fast natural speed.

reading.text: Read with ease virtually all abstract, structurally complex, specialised, and literary written language.

speaking.text: Deliver smooth logically structured communication that highlights significant points and fine shades of meaning.

writing.text: Create complex letters, reports, articles, summaries, and reviews in an effective reader-appropriate style.

oral.text: Participate effortlessly, use idiomatic language appropriately, and repair so smoothly that difficulty is unobtrusive.

written_online.text: Use an appropriate tone in virtually any interaction and anticipate cultural, emotional, or communication problems.

mediation.text: Reconstruct and evaluate arguments, convey nuance and sociocultural implications, and guide complex discussion sensitively.

range.text: Comprehensive precise language that differentiates, emphasises, and eliminates ambiguity without visible restriction.

grammar.text: Consistent control of complex language even while attention is divided across planning and interaction.

vocabulary.text: Very broad idiomatic and colloquial repertoire with awareness of connotation and fine meaning distinctions.

pronunciation.text: Precise articulation and prosody enhance subtle meaning; retained accent does not reduce intelligibility or effectiveness.

discourse.text: Create fully coherent and cohesive communication using flexible organisational and rhetorical patterns.

fluency.text: Sustain natural effortless flow, pausing mainly to select the most precise formulation or example.

assessment_evidence.text: Precise nuance under realistic cognitive load
